title: Corridor demand heat map
summary: Find Ride now shows where passengers are waiting on a live heat map — warm hubs on Tech Junction, Kejetia, KNUST, and Ayeduase before you walk to the stop.

title: Trip chat with your mate
summary: After a reservation or bid is accepted, passengers and mates can chat in-app with quick replies and optional auto-translate.

title: Smart Fare Lock
summary: Lock your quoted fare for five minutes when corridor demand spikes — no surprise cedi bumps while you wait for the van.

title: Refer friends, earn GHS 5
summary: Share your invite code — earn GHS 5 when a friend completes their first ride. New riders get 3% off their first trip.

title: Live-only trips & bid sync
summary: Browse feeds show mates with active GPS only. Bids reach the mate dashboard in real time with pickup codes on accept.

title: Trotro Market cart
summary: Add listings to cart and checkout from wallet or cash meetup — local commerce inside the app.

title: Asokwa to Santasi corridor live
summary: TrotroOS now supports the Asokwa–Santasi corridor with real-time queue tracking and seat reservations for morning and evening rush hours.

title: TrotroRide pilot launch
summary: Shared-car mode is available on the Tech Junction ↔ Ayeduase corridor with incoming offer sheets and live GPS for mid-route pickups.

title: MoMo cashout for mates
summary: Mates can cash out earnings to mobile money wallets after trips, with same-day processing for verified operators.

title: Trip Guardian safety update
summary: Trip Guardian can notify emergency contacts when a trip deviates from its planned route or stops unexpectedly for an extended period.

title: Station Master analytics
summary: Station operators get peak-hour predictions, volume trends, and dispatch recommendations based on live corridor demand.
